domain: Rational number arithmetic (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert to fractions
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers and/or whole numbers as equivalent fractions (often improper or with a target denominator) to enable fraction operations.
inclusion_criteria: Converting a mixed number a b/c into an improper fraction (ac+b)/c
Interpreting nonstandard mixed forms (e.g., 1 4/3 as 1 + 4/3) and converting to an improper fraction
Rewriting an integer n as a fraction (n/1) or as an equivalent fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 3 = 15/5, 2 = 16/8)
exclusion_criteria: Converting two fractions to a shared/common denominator (tag S02 instead)
Performing the subtraction once forms are compatible (tag S03 instead)
Reducing/simplifying the computed result or converting the final answer to mixed/integer form (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common (often least common) denominator and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Choosing a common denominator (explicitly via LCM or implicitly) for two fractions
Scaling numerator and denominator to express fractions over the chosen common denominator (e.g., 5/3 = 20/12, 3/4 = 9/12)
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and no conversion is needed (tag S03 instead)
Only converting mixed/whole numbers to fractions without the goal of aligning denominators (tag S01 instead)

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are in compatible form (e.g., same denominator or separated whole and fractional parts).
inclusion_criteria: Subtracting numerators over a common denominator (a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b)
Subtracting when denominators are already the same
Subtracting mixed numbers by separating whole-part and fractional-part differences
exclusion_criteria: Steps whose main purpose is converting inputs to fractions or matching denominators (tag S01 or S02 instead)
Reducing/simplifying or reformatting the final result (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Simplify and format
skills.definition: Express the computed result in simplest accepted form by reducing fractions and/or converting between improper fractions, mixed numbers, and integers.
inclusion_criteria: Reducing a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
Stating a fraction is already in lowest terms
Rewriting results as integers (e.g., 8/8 = 1, 0/3 = 0) or converting an improper fraction to a mixed number
exclusion_criteria: Any conversion done primarily to enable subtraction (tag S01 or S02 instead)
The subtraction computation itself (tag S03 instead)
